## Personality

Judson Parker is a jovial and smooth-spoken man characterized by his uniformly good-natured and bland demeanor. Despite these pleasant traits, he notably has very few friends.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)_

## History

Judson Parker was a voter who consistently supported Grant. When he planned to rent his fences to a medicine company for painted advertisements, a committee of young women from the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) tried unsuccessfully to dissuade him. However, after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally witnessed him receiving a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md), Judson agreed to drop the advertisement plan to prevent her from exposing him and ruining his reputation.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), +2 more_
